reader_summary.headline: Kip McDaniel is the Chief Content Officer and Editorial Director at Institutional Investor.
reader_summary.overview: Kip McDaniel is the Chief Content Officer and Editorial Director at Institutional Investor. Prior to joining II a year ago, Kip spent seven years as the Founding Editor and Editor-in-Chief of CIO Magazine. Kip is a graduate of Harvard College, received a Master's at Cambridge University, and was an elite crew rower.
